question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 L 组：克罗地亚 vs 加纳（90 分钟三路赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group L: Croatia vs Ghana (90-minute three-way result)?
one_liner_cn: Elo 差距 402 分叠加加纳核心库杜斯伤缺，克罗地亚明显占优；变数在于第三轮可能的轮换与动力下降。
one_liner_en: A 402-point Elo gap plus Ghana losing Kudus makes Croatia the clear favourite; matchday-3 rotation is the main wildcard.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 积分差 402 分（克罗地亚 1912 / 第 12 vs 加纳 1510 / 第 81），统计模型给出克罗地亚约 76% 基线胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 402-point Elo gap (Croatia 1912 / 12th vs Ghana 1510 / 81st) yields a ~76% baseline win probability for Croatia.

key_reasons.cn: 加纳头号球星库杜斯因大腿长期伤势无缘世界杯，主力中卫萨利苏（ACL）与吉库也缺席，攻防核心同时受损。
key_reasons.en: Ghana's star Mohammed Kudus is out with a long-term thigh injury, and first-choice centre-backs Salisu (ACL) and Djiku are also missing.

key_reasons.cn: 本场为 L 组第三轮，克罗地亚若已提前出线存在轮换与动力下降风险；莫德里奇 40 岁、科瓦契奇跟腱伤后状态待察。
key_reasons.en: As Group L matchday 3, Croatia may rotate if already qualified; Modric is 40 and Kovacic is returning from Achilles problems.

method_note: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus): p_stat Croatia 75.8% / Draw 16.7% / Ghana 7.5%; bounded evidence adjustment ~3pp (Ghana injuries vs Croatia rotation risk) -> p_final. Market-blind: no betting or prediction-market inputs.
